seo_title: Find Transfer Scholarships for International Students USA
seo_description: Transfer scholarships for international students in the USA. Compare awards, review varying deadlines, and explore structured listing details to apply.
intro: Trying to find USA scholarships that fit both transfer plans and international student status usually means sorting through mixed eligibility rules, study levels, and subject areas. This filtered slice brings those listings into one place so you can compare options more quickly and apply with better context. The programs below span themes such as education, STEM, community, medicine, arts, and other miscellaneous categories, with examples tied to fields like engineering, business, English, and health professions. Awards vary by listing, deadlines differ across rows, and requirements are not uniform: some opportunities may ask for essays while others appear lighter-touch. Because some deadlines are relatively soon, it is smart to check each row promptly and review details on the provider application path before you move forward.
h1: Find USA Transfer Scholarships for International Students
supporting: Use this list to compare more than just the scholarship title. Read the requirement lines closely for transfer eligibility, international student wording, study level fit, and any field-of-study preference. It also helps to compare award text and deadline language side by side, since amounts vary and timing is not the same across programs. When a provider application path is available, ScholarshipTop includes it so you can move from shortlist to submission more easily.
related_intro: If these results feel close but not quite right, related pages can help you narrow by study level, subject area, or other international-student scholarship themes. That is often the fastest way to find a better match before you start applying.

faq.question: How can I find transfer scholarships for international students in the USA on this page?
faq.answer: Use this filtered view to explore programs tagged for international students and compare each row’s study level, category, and field of study. Then review provider-path context in ScholarshipTop for any scholarship you want to apply to, since eligibility details can differ a lot by listing.

faq.question: Can I compare award amounts and deadlines across these transfer scholarship listings?
faq.answer: Yes—these rows include deadline text, and many listings show award amounts, but both vary by program. Amounts can range widely, so compare the catalog rows first and review the current amount and deadline on the provider application path before you apply.

faq.question: Are these scholarships only for one major or academic area?
faq.answer: No. This filtered set includes multiple topic areas such as Education, STEM, Community, Medicine, Arts, and Miscellaneous, with sample fields including engineering, business, English, health professions, and education. If you want to browse more efficiently, use the row details to compare subject fit before clicking through.

faq.question: Do all transfer scholarships for international students require an essay?
faq.answer: Not necessarily—requirements vary across the listings on this page. Some programs may have lighter application requirements, but you should always review provider-path context in ScholarshipTop to understand whether an essay or other materials are needed.
